validation_type: independent live Codex thread forward-testing with human acceptance

runs.finding: Improved duplicate/index detection but missed lifecycle drift and the GCW family.
Caught more lifecycle verbs and all duplicate managers, but still used older evidence for some durable results and did not close the GCW family.
Correctly found web-ai-daily-paper, Vue migration, idea/index, product idea, and weekly-report lifecycle issues; family output remained incomplete.

runs.scenario: live renumber GCW across visible history
runs.finding: Separated Skills and gc-workflow-helper contexts and refused unsafe global numbering across a large ambiguous historical family.

runs.scenario: early four-thread GCW family relationship review
runs.finding: Overweighted the latest status/handoff interaction and misclassified durable implementation ownership, leading to the durable-task versus latest-interaction correction.
Distinguished implementation ownership, handoff, independent changes, and duplicate/parallel release uncertainty without forcing a sequence.

runs.scenario: final scoped live scan of eight anomaly candidates and two Automation threads
runs.finding: Surfaced all eight non-protected lifecycle/title candidates, skipped both Automation threads, and identified a 01/02 handoff family. Minor count wording and cwd-prefix redundancy were corrected afterward.

runs.scenario: final user-run scan of the 20 most recent real threads using the globally installed skill
runs.finding: Previewed nine high-confidence lifecycle and object-first renames, protected two Automation/system threads, kept three old manager entries as archive candidates, and forced no uncertain numbering family.

runs.scenario: user-confirmed application and verification of the final preview
runs.finding: Applied and re-verified all nine confirmed renames with zero failures; no archive or needs-review item was mutated.
